title.narrative: Towards an Inclusive and Peaceful Society in Mozambique (TIPS)

description.narrative: The overall objective seeks to contribute to conflict prevention, crisis preparedness and response and peace building through inclusive natural resource governance and management in Mozambique. The specific objective of the action is to strengthen the leadership and capacities of civil society actors to prevent and address natural resource based conflicts through multi-stakeholder dialogue and engagement at multiple levels.
